title: Indonesia Digital Lending
thesis: Snowflake turns daily repayment activity from a synthetic Indonesian digital lender into on-time repayment and PAR 30 KPIs, 14-day missed-instalment risk scores, e-wallet inflow anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: On-time repayment rate, missed instalments, PAR 30 and outstanding for 200 borrowers across Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan and Makassar.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to borrower-day rows.
The product chart shows which loan products miss the most instalments.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of portfolio KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which borrowers should collectors call first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each borrower's probability of missing an instalment in the next 14 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags e-wallet inflow drops per borrower, and the forecast projects portfolio missed instalments for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

talking_points: Promise-to-pay rate, document coverage and pending documents frame the collection and underwriting gaps.
Alternative-data score against missed instalments by borrower shows an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, borrower, product and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when an instalment is missed right now?

talking_points: Live repayment events land in RAW.LIVE_REPAYMENTS, from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs MISSED events with the matching collection playbook and the borrower's current risk band, then emails the collections lead.
tabs.call_out: From missed payment to collection action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over 15 synthetic collection playbooks.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the playbooks it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
